description: The AVX-512 refinement receipt from commit 9473af6, fully aligned to the custody schema. Build artifact identity filled from sandbox compilation (rustc 1.97.1, matching the CI toolchain). Observation independence filled by relabeling existing evidence. All nine invariants should pass — this is the Issue #27 closure fixture.
expected_reason: All nine invariants pass. The existing AVX-512 execution evidence, combined with sandbox-derived build identity, satisfies the custody framework.
_closure_notes: This fixture represents the closure of Issue #27. The AVX-512 execution evidence (canary, 135 staged comparisons, backend parity) was already captured at commit 9473af6. The build artifact identity was filled by compiling the code at 9473af6 in the sandbox with the same toolchain (rustc 1.97.1, matching the CI environment recorded in stage2_verification.json). The observation independence was filled by relabeling existing evidence (EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1 feature probe, tests/ vs src/ harness isolation, reference.rs oracle independence). No hardware re-execution was needed. No phone builds were needed.

claim_scope.claimed_scope: AVX-512 NTT computes the same mathematical object as reference (DIF NTT = DFT), with backend equivalence at every stage
claim_scope.verified_scope: 135 staged comparisons across 6 sizes (n=32..1024), 45 stages x 3 backends. 14/14 backend parity tests pass. Hardware canary: 16 lanes x 1 butterfly, 0 mismatches. Spot-check: n=256, 4096, 65536 all match.

execution._evidence: EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1: run_id 'backend_parity_1544BEEFCAFE4242', avx512 butterfly coverage: 16, parity passed: true, mismatches: 0.

hardware.feature_probe_method: is_x86_feature_detected!('avx512f') && is_x86_feature_detected!('avx512dq') — recorded in EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1 backend_identity.cpu_features

test.name: staged_cross_backend_equivalence + avx512_execution_canary + backend_parity_evidence
test.oracle: reference NTT (u128 oracle, no shared code with implementation)
test.oracle_independence: Reference oracle in src/field/babybear/reference.rs, composed from babybear_mul_reference + babybear_add/sub_reference. Implementation in src/avx512_butterfly_32bit.rs. No shared code path.

observation.observer: test harness (tests/babybear_domain.rs, tests/ntt_equivalence.rs) + EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1 runtime probe (src/core/environment.rs)
observation.independence_note: Feature probe: EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1 records cpu_features ['avx512f', 'avx512dq'] via runtime is_x86_feature_detected!() call in src/core/environment.rs. Harness isolation: tests are in tests/ directory, implementation in src/avx512_butterfly_32bit.rs, oracle in src/field/babybear/reference.rs — three separate modules with no shared code. Staged comparison: 135 element-by-element comparisons across 45 stages and 3 backends. Hardware canary: 16 lanes x 1 butterfly, 0 mismatches. The observation mechanism is structurally separate from the code under test.
